original_description: Create, edit, lay out, and export designs in Affinity Designer/Publisher/Photo (the Canva-owned desktop apps) by writing JavaScript scripts and running them through the Affinity MCP. Prefer this skill over the canva-design skill once a project has moved to Affinity.
